lines.note: Gross 378.60 = net 315.50 + VAT 63.10. Variance accepted (policy 4): invoice net 315.50 against PO-1044 net 300.00 is 15.50 over, limit 50.00. Supplier's reason: the corrected letterhead line is 2000 sheets at the agreed 82.75 per thousand (165.50) plus business cards 150.00; the PO list gives only the 300.00 total, so the rate was not checked against the PO. Corrected version (sent 17 Sep) supersedes the 16 Sep version (gross 372.60); the invoice number is paid once (policy 5). No approval needed: 2000.00 or less (policy 3), approved_by is null. Not in the bank feed (feed ends 29 Sep). Paid to the supplier master's details. The 26 Sep email asking to change them was declined by the principal (mail #6 from human): 'Do not update the details; pay Northfield to the details on file.' The principal will make the call-back on the number on file and treats the .co email as suspected fraud. No agent replies to it (policies 8 and 9). Due 2026-10-16.

Approved by the principal, approval reference mail #6 from human. Item 2 of the principal's reply, as quoted by the reconciler (I have not seen the principal's message itself): 'Marlow MD-2026-057: approved. Pay 5,400.00 GBP in this run on 2 October.' Approval was needed because gross 5400.00 (net 4500.00 + VAT 900.00) is above 2000.00 (policy 3). The reply does not restate the account; the payment goes to the supplier master's details (policy 8), which are unchanged, and no bank-detail change request has been received for Marlow. Net 4500.00 equals PO-1039 net, no variance. Sent 15 and 22 Sep, one invoice, paid once (policy 5). Credit note CN-012 (300.00) was already refunded on 10 Sep, so nothing is offset and the full gross is payable (policy 7). Not in the bank feed (feed ends 29 Sep). Due 2026-10-15.

HOLD by the principal's decision, reference mail #6 from human. Item 3 of the principal's reply, as quoted by the reconciler: 'Kestrel 7731: hold. Do not pay it in this run; it goes in the FX run on 7 October. Keep it on the run as HOLD.' So it is not paid in this run and goes in the FX run on 7 October 2026, before the 2026-10-12 due date. No USD wire is authorised in this run, so approved_by is null. The invoice is in USD (960.00, net 960.00, no VAT) and the policy covers only GBP payments from the main current account (policy 2), which is why the principal decided (policy 10). No rate assumed, nothing converted, not in total_gbp. Net equals PO-1046 (USD 960.00), no variance. Not in the bank feed (feed ends 29 Sep). Bank fields are the supplier master's USD routing number and account.
